column1: # Lua source L2 calibration (tools/luasrc.py calibrate). Sets: march-t0 = files whose exact source is known (sibling
# .src.lua / ClientScript T0), so any miss is an ljd or checker defect; march-nogt = every March bytecode file in the 4 kom
# dirs that have no exact source at all (data001, data014, data119, datai022; verdict only, no ground truth); june =
# june2017_re/june_lua against ljconv(June); class = the nine data036 class scripts (C3d-4). Exact sources exist in only
# 11 of the 15 kom dirs with .lua. Every non-T0/T1 row has a cause read from its full T1 diff.
# Verdicts follow the user rule of 2026-10-09 (a table constant compares as its key/value pairs in its own table;
# storage order ignored). Every miss of the runs below was re-checked under it; the 6 former layout-only rows were
# re-decompiled and are now T1. reordered_tables = tables holding the same pairs in another storage order (information).
# luasrc.py calibrate --sets march-t0,march-nogt --seed L2 --per-dir 25 --quota data037=40 --quota data040=35 --quota data035=35 (2026-10-09)
